label: sub-issue
sub
definition: One deliverable of an effort, tracked as a native GitHub sub-issue of the parent and titled [Effort <parent>] <N> · <Title>. Sequential subs commit straight onto the effort branch, one commit each; parallel subs get a sub/<N><letter> worktree and merge in. In Scrum terms a sub-issue is a task of the sprint backlog.
is_not: A checkbox in the parent's body: a checkbox has no state outside the body and leaves the board when the parent closes.
A task: a task has its own PR; a sub-issue lands inside the effort's one PR.
A step of a plan file: the sub-issue is the tracker, a plan table is an index of it.
